test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the given figure, DE is parallel to BC . Angle ABC = 40 degrees. Angle ADE = 130 degrees. What is the value (in degrees) of angle BAD ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a88e4313088abeea0f7c7394039b57610542b868646edb8ab8df3209e920bd44.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Draw an auxiliary line through A parallel to BC and DE.

The angle ∠BAD is split into two parts by this parallel line.

Part 1 = Alternate interior angle to ∠ABC = 40°.

Part 2 = Supplementary angle to ∠ADE (Co-interior) = 180° − 130° = 50°.

Total ∠BAD = 40° + 50° = 90°.

**∴ The correct answer is 90°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Line DE || Line BC

∠ABC = 40°

∠ADE = 130°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b521706f0d2ff08cef730c058fe1cff01c9292869f95bdc012f6af8a97e21f7c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Draw a line AX parallel to BC passing through point A.

⇒ Since AX || BC, ∠XAB = ∠ABC (Alternate Interior Angles)

⇒ ∠XAB = 40°

⇒ Since AX || DE, ∠XAD + ∠ADE = 180° (Consecutive Interior Angles)

⇒ ∠XAD + 130° = 180°

⇒ ∠XAD = 180° − 130° = 50°

⇒ ∠BAD = ∠XAB + ∠XAD

⇒ ∠BAD = 40° + 50° = 90°

**∴ The correct answer is 90°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alternate Interior Angles

When a transversal intersects two parallel lines, each pair of alternate interior angles is equal.

Consecutive Interior Angles

Also known as co-interior angles, the sum of these angles on the same side of the transversal is 180°.

Parallel Line Properties

If two lines are parallel to the same line, then they are parallel to each other.
